made: during development, after the first development preparation run and before any evaluation structure was selected, downloaded or scored

reason.G2: the TopoFold core receives float32 coordinates, so the rigid-motion invariance of the T representation is limited to about 5e-6, not 1e-6 (observed 4.6e-6); the float64 representations keep a tight limit
reason.anchors: UniProt active-site annotations are not reliable across kinases (MAPK14 lists residue 168, the DFG Asp, with reference ILD there; AURKA has two ATP-binding Lys); the first run excluded MAPK14, AURKA and CDK2 for anchor reasons
reason.controls: MAPK14 and CDK2 were excluded by the anchor rules, so the controls 1KV2 and 1FIN could not be tested; the cyclin-bound CDK2 control cannot be replaced from CDK2 entries

anchors.domain_and_beta3_Lys: UniProt 'Protein kinase' domains; a domain qualifies if it holds exactly one UniProt ATP-binding-site Lys at domain start + 20 to + 40 (the six development kinases have it at + 26 to + 29); exactly one qualifying domain is needed
anchors.HRD_H: MotifWindow(beta3 Lys + 70, beta3 Lys + 125): exactly one HRD or YRD (development spacing 86 to 98)
anchors.DFG_Asp: MotifWindow(beta3 Lys + 95, beta3 Lys + 140): exactly one DFG (development spacing 110 to 120)

controls.in: every PRKACA development entry; at least 90 % of them must be assigned in
controls.basis: published structures: an imatinib-Abl complex, a BIRB-796-p38 complex and a sorafenib-BRAF complex (type II inhibitors) for out; PKA catalytic-subunit structures are in the DFG-in state; sanity gate only

unchanged: evaluation kinase list and ranking, stopping rule, representations, scoring procedure, metric, outcomes and the other gates
